parse_chess_move_san: parse a chess move in SAN notation against a board state and return the validated move
handle_ambiguous_chess_moves: handle ambiguous chess moves by resolving them against legal moves using a seeded random choice
clean_chess_notation: clean and normalize chess move strings by stripping move numbers, dots, and annotation characters

use_chess_soft_parser_class: use the ChessSoftParser class to parse chess moves from text input via the SoftMoveParser interface
